messages:
Anna (Partnerships): Quick sync — marketplace launch readiness for Tue 04/09. Can each team confirm green for: press embargo, blog + assets, marketplace listing content, SI integration blurb, and landing page?
Eli (Marketing): Press embargo ok from our side, embargo memo sent to distro list. Blog draft is at 90% — need final screenshots. :rocket:
Gwen (Product): SI integration blurb ready. Need one last line from hardware partner about supported SKUs.
Jess (Partner Ops): I have the SKUs coming from HW partner this afternoon. Marketplace listing for GCP/Azure still waiting on final pricing table from finance.
Sam (Eng): Landing page performance tests passed. CDN TTLs set. We need the final 2 hero images (desktop + mobile) from design to avoid visual regressions.
Eli (Marketing): Picking hero shots now, will drop links in this thread by EOD. Also adding a short customer quote — @Jess can you confirm PR permission?
Jess (Partner Ops): Confirmed — legal looped and customer ok for short quote.
Ravi (Legal): Quick heads up — the joint announcement language needs one small tweak for the SI mention. I pushed comments in the doc: https://docs.redwood.ai/announce/draft (see inline).
Gwen (Product): Noted. Will update doc after comment review. Also we should include the fallback model variant note for Dedicated customers on the landing page.
Sam (Eng): Adding a tiny note: our routing demo snippet uses the new api key header. Copy for docs:
```
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate
```
Make sure ops don't expose a live key in the blog.
Eli (Marketing): Good call. Use sandbox key in screenshots.
PressBot: Reminder — embargo lifts 2026-04-09 15:00 UTC. Auto-post scheduled if no updates by 2026-04-09 14:30 UTC.
Anna (Partnerships): Owner map: Marketing = Eli (blog + press), Product = Gwen (SI copy + feature callouts), Partner Ops = Jess (partner approvals + SKUs), Eng = Sam (landing + snippets), Legal = Ravi (signoff). If anyone can't hit EOD, call it out now.
Jess (Partner Ops): Small blocker: one hardware partner requires logo approval from their comms team; ETA 24 hrs. We can ship without logo but mention "in partnership with" text placeholder.
Eli (Marketing): Can we use a neutral co-marketing line if logo delayed? e.g., "in collaboration with our hardware partners" — acceptable?
Ravi (Legal): That phrasing is fine. Keep logo off until formal approval.
Gwen (Product): Rehearsal plan: can we do a 15-min dry run Mon 04/08 16:00 PT with comms + SI reps? I want to test the landing CTA flows and the marketplace purchase button.
Anna (Partnerships): Yes schedule it. @Jess please invite SI reps and hardware comms. Eli please rehearse the press timeline.
Jess (Partner Ops): On it. Invite sent.
Sam (Eng): For cutover, I'll run a smoke test checklist (post below). Anyone want to add items?
Sam (Eng): ```
- Verify marketplace listing links
- Test purchase flow in sandbox
- Validate CDN assets and hero images
- Ensure fallback model variant route working
- Check monitoring alerts and SLO pages
```
Eli (Marketing): Adding one: confirm syndicated blog syndication metadata (open graph + AMP).
Anna (Partnerships): Great. Final asks: drop final hero images + pricing table + hardware logo decision by EOD tomorrow. If all green, we proceed with embargo lift as scheduled. Thanks everyone! :tada:
